headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 22, 2026, the portfolio set is showing an average return of 22.93%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.66%. This translates to an average alpha of 10.26%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 38.70%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned -3.82%, highlighting the variability within the set. The ability to outperform SPY during this period is a strong indicator of resilience amid potential market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
